Row.Text: Torn between the ambitions of its neighbors, Goryeo flourishes in adversity. Melding martial skill with poetry, they fight as fiercely with arrows as they do with words, and forges for steel alternate with kilns for delicate stoneware. Guide Goryeo through the fire, that it may emerge both strong and full of beauty.
Goryeo favors Unique Improvements, but that is not limited to their own. You can also benefit from Unique Improvements gained from a City-State, or even from a previous Age.
